notes.title: A new patch has been uploaded. [18/02/2018]
notes.content:
[h1]The new fixes are here![/h1]

Hello people!  We have uploaded the new patch and we hope this fixes any errors that have been reported. We have created the patch also so it keeps any previous save files that you may have. (This was a real headache!)

If you are having any difficulties please Email us at contact@worldofdasm.com 

[b][u]Here is the list of fixes.[/u][/b]
[list]
    [*] The World of DASM, DASM Spell Quest exe sometimes shows as a possible virus but isn't.
    [*] Every time you run the World of DASM, DASM Spell Quest exe you have to agree with the license agreement.
    [*] Shadow on post in the Introduction screen was incorrect.
    [*] Introduction screen hands still show after character has teleported.
    [*] World of DASM city Aunty May missions, a spare bridge mesh is near the entrance of the DASM city.
    [*] Aunty May missions, lighting needs to be rebuilt error.
    [*] Helgas Town Hall missions, lighting needs to be rebuilt error.
    [*] Goblins place missions, lighting needs to be rebuilt error.
    [*] ABC Map Moonbase, black squares can be seen in the sky instead of space.
[/list] 

Please contact us know if you find any other issues. We will be constantly checking for messages here for the next 48 hours to make sure the patch has transitioned successfully. 

You can post here within STEAM also if you do not wish to Email us:  http://steamcommunity.com/app/543910/discussions/0/1354868867706525555/

Thank you.

notes.title: Latest Patch and Free Expansion,”DASM Outskirts” is to be released very soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/230ba2a56c80cdaccf2e355af917b3b0b7f6199c.jpg[/img]
Hello people how are we? I have some great news for all the DASM fans that emailed us and said that they are half way through the game and have quite a few spelling tokens left in their inventory.  If you are not aware DASM Spell Quest allows you to carry a maximum of 100 spelling tokens so you must spend the tokens as you collect them. (There is a chance this may change in the future.) Unfortunately the current problem is even if you do spend your tokens at the shops you will still have a few tokens left over and this has become an issue.
Therefore DASM Outskirts has been created to fix this problem. Now the good news is this expansion will be free because of the wonderful feedback from parents, guardians and teachers who use our software. Yes that’s right, just from contacting us and providing us feedback we are happy to please!
[b][h1]What does this expansion have to offer?[/h1][/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/e93144b811a0a0c23171c81a7c0fc421fa0c10a1.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Own your very own motel room![/u][/b]
Why not buy a motel room and purchase some furniture for it? Go shopping and buy some goods from 3 stores to decorate your own home. Even if you don’t have enough to buy a room the motel owner will still let you decorate it. (But it will still cost you!)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/dfe416425eeef887d37586cac358ca4e0b1148ee.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Caravan Park. (Trailer Park.)[/u][/b]
Want to buy some used caravans? Want a place to own with some great scenery? Buy a caravan!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/df7ff7f7a957ec21c8c9c98e9e2a107cfb583b8c.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Businesses.[/u][/b]
Want to purchase a business? Got enough tokens? Are you a business person? Then become even more of a citizen of DASM by buying various properties.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/0c33355dfcd4c0152a45fe781826c9ef4439f588.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Library.[/u][/b]
Need to return a lost overdue library book? Well you have come to the right place! The library will give out a reward for any lost books returned. You can also buy books and shelving here for your motel room if you wish to do so.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28784825/5336b67af9ac6396f95925ca9e5ac0feaa163311.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Missions.[/u][/b]
There are only a few missions to do in the expansion because it was mainly created so you can spend  spelling tokens and have a little time out from doing all the puzzles. DASM Outskirts does not offer too much for you if you don’t have any tokens to spend.

[b][h1]Final words.[/h1][/b]
We feel it is our duty to try and make our software more playable and fun by listening to comments and feedback that anyone has for us. 
We also want to make it clear to save any confusion that this game is for “children only” who are just starting to learn or are having learning difficulties. So please, especially anyone who has comments for us make sure you understand the fundamental principles of this game before you comment publically.
 If you’re not sure what to say here in STEAM email us at: [b]feedback@worldofdasm.com[/b] and we will gladly listen to what you have to say. (Most people do!)

Please don’t forget to report any bugs!
Report any bugs here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/543910/discussions/0/1354868867706525555/
Thank you.

notes.title: Latest patch is now out!
notes.content:
Hello people!  We have released a second patch to tidy up a few things that were overlooked during testing. Special thanks to everyone that emailed us directly via our website and reported some issues.
[list]
[*] Wizard hat puzzle would not save.
[*] Wizard would always say beware before walking through the tunnel to the city when it is not supposed to and the gates would remain shut.
[*] Wizard could be physically seen after saying beware on the other side of the tower instead of disappearing.
[*] Added new feature where after the game is patched it won’t restart in a minimized screen.
[*] Cleaned up some messy commands and fixed a few save bugs.
[*] Fixed the Train Station map where the graphics and lighting was set way too bright or incorrectly and some of the textures were not displaying right.
[/list]
We are currently working on a 3rd patch but this will be quite large and involves changing some of the settings in the DASM City maps.
Please email us or place a message here if you’re having any problems: http://steamcommunity.com/app/543910/discussions/0/1354868867706525555/ 

Thank you.
